== History ==
'''Disney Devils''' attended QDay3 where they lost the 4-4 finals against [[Image:flag_de.gif]] [[Schroet Kommando]]. This was surrounded by some controversy as, due to several delays in the competitions, the '''DD''' team was in very serious hurry to leave in time to catch a ferry.
